display.purpose: The one focal money figure on a screen; serif only because it is money.

title.purpose: The single h1 per screen, sheet / modal titles, empty-state titles.

h2.purpose: Serif amounts inside cards (request card take-home) and overlay titles. Never a section heading.

figure.purpose: Non-money focal fact: a visit time, "2h left", the tailor-row estimate.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and row labels (500 for labels and inputs).

body-strong.purpose: Buttons, text links, chips, row titles, amounts.

small.purpose: Captions, meta lines, helpers; the status word at 600.

caps.purpose: sectionHead(): 12 px sans caps +1 px in neutral-600; labels like YOU TAKE HOME.

micro.purpose: Change tags (New, New price, Removed), sentence case with caps tracking.

shadows.name: card-ring
shadows.purpose: The only depth for in-page content: an inside chalk ring on tissue for touchable groups.

shadows.name: action-halo
shadows.purpose: Halo around the "your move" status dot.

shadows.name: unread-ring
shadows.purpose: Separates the 8 px unread dot from the nav icon.

shadows.name: push-lift
shadows.purpose: In-app push banner over the status bar.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for press, sheets, modals, toasts.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Reserved for on-screen movement between two states.

motion.name: dur-press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on every tappable surface.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Press transform: scale(0.97); transform only, never transition: all.

motion.name: dur-sheet-in
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet and push banner entering.

motion.name: dur-modal
motion.purpose: Modal enter from translateY(8px) scale(0.98) + opacity; never from scale 0.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Transforms off for press, sheets, modals; colour / opacity transitions stay at 150 ms or less.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: The only layout width; the stage is max-width 390.

breakpoints.name: desktop-backdrop
breakpoints.purpose: Above this the body turns neutral-100 around the centred phone stage.

narrative.overview: Taily should feel like standing at a good tailor's counter: unbleached linen under your hands, a receipt book written in pencil, the garment on the hanger in front of you. Sarah books between meetings; Amara answers between fittings with pins in her mouth. Both glance, decide, and put the phone down. So the surface is calm and warm, the hierarchy is legible at a squint, and nothing competes with the one decision on the screen. It is an app for running an errand, not a dashboard. Every screen reads in the same order: a serif title, then one focal fact or figure, then quiet groups of rows separated by air, then one black button. Depth is almost absent. The page is linen (`neutral-50`), and only things you can touch are lifted onto tissue-white cards with a chalk ring. Colour is rationed: graphite ink does the work, basting-thread brown (`accent-*`) marks "your move", and warm semantic tones (sage, ochre, green, brick) speak only through small status dots and money states. There is no blue anywhere. Personality comes from exactly two signatures, both locked by Kevin in K-03: **the garment illustrations** (wherever a garment appears, including photo placeholders and empty states) and **the stitched dash** (a perforation above every money total, like the tear line on a ticket stub). Everything else stays out of the way. The product is a 390 px phone web app with no bottom tab bar: an icon-only top nav, a focused flow bar during booking, and a sticky action bar for the one primary action.
keyCharacteristics: Linen page, tissue cards with an inside chalk ring, and only for interactive groups.
Serif (Cormorant Garamond) only for page titles, overlay titles and the one hero money figure. Everything else is Hanken Grotesk.
Section headings whisper: 12 px sans caps in graphite, never serif.
Status = an 8 px warm dot plus a 12 px word. No coloured chips, no blue.
One filled ink button per screen; every other action is an accent text link.
Two signatures only: garment illustrations and the stitched dash.
Space separates groups (8 inside, 32 between, 40 around the hero); lines separate only rows inside a list.
Money prints as dollar amounts only, never percentages, with one precision per group.

rules.name: The No-Blue Rule
rules.body: Nothing ships in blue. `--info`, `--info-bg` and `--media-placeholder` stay defined (they are Figma variables) but no screen or component may reference them; `.c-info` and `.banner--info` resolve to Thread Ink on Tissue Wash.

rules.name: The Base-Is-For-Glyphs Rule (D-163)
rules.body: Each semantic colour has a base (dots, glyphs, strokes, fills under white text) and an `-ink` (text). Text in a semantic tone always uses the `-ink` token; `neutral-500` is a stroke colour and `neutral-500-ink` is its text twin.

rules.name: The Your-Move Rule (D-95)
rules.body: Accent marks whose turn it is. The action status is the loudest on any list (bold word, accent dot with a 3 px Tissue Wash halo). An added charge is not a success, so "New" tags are accent, not green.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-A-Name Rule (K-03)
rules.body: Cormorant appears only for a page or overlay title and for hero money. A serif section heading, serif row, serif button or serif number in a list is wrong. `.t-section` (serif 20) is retired in v5.

rules.name: The Whisper Heading Rule
rules.body: Section headings are `h2.t-caps.c-600`: small, graphite, uppercase. The content under them leads.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount, time and count sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (`.tabular`) so columns align and figures do not jitter as they change. Never let Cormorant render numbers in running text (its old-style figures read "IIzoI").

rules.name: The Space-Is-The-Separator Rule
rules.body: Groups are separated by air, not lines or boxes. A screen stylesheet may not invent another vertical gap between groups. Lines exist only between rows inside one list.

rules.name: The Squint Rule
rules.body: At a squint each screen reads: serif title, one focal fact or figure, quiet groups, one black button. If two things shout, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Tissue-Under-A-Finger Rule
rules.body: White plus a chalk ring means "you can touch this". Never put reference content in a card, and never give a card a drop shadow.

dos: **Do** take every colour, space, radius and size from `css/tokens.css`; screens contain no hex, no rgba and no literal px font size.
**Do** keep one filled ink button per screen and make every other action a Thread Ink text link (44 px tall).
**Do** put a garment illustration wherever a garment is named as a title, and a photo stub (tone gradient + tilted garment) wherever a photo would be.
**Do** put exactly one stitched dash above a money total, and nowhere except the two sanctioned places.
**Do** use `sectionHead()` (12 px sans caps, Graphite Soft) for every section heading, and `.t-figure` for a non-money hero fact.
**Do** print status as `statusPill()`: an 8 px warm dot plus a 12/600 word.
**Do** use `.card` (Tissue, 16 radius, inside Chalk ring, 16 padding) only for groups the user can touch.
**Do** separate groups with the 8 / 12 / 32 / 40 rhythm and draw lines only between rows inside one list.
**Do** use the `-ink` variant for any text in a semantic or accent colour (D-163), and `neutral-600` for footnotes.
**Do** animate press with `scale(0.97)` over 120 ms `--ease-out`, sheets 280 / 200 ms, modals 220 ms, and turn transforms off under `prefers-reduced-motion` and `html.is-test`.
**Do** print money as dollar amounts only (`fmt / fmtExact / fmtNeg / fmtColumn`), one precision per group, tabular figures.
donts: **Don't** use blue: no `--info`, `--info-bg` or `--media-placeholder` anywhere, and never `--component` (Figma's default purple).
**Don't** set serif type for section headings, rows, buttons or list numbers; never use `.t-section` (20 px) or an off-scale size.
**Don't** add a bottom tab bar, text labels in the top nav, or photo / black-square avatars.
**Don't** add a third signature: no extra ornaments, illustrations in non-garment contexts, textures or decorative dividers.
**Don't** give cards drop shadows or put reference content (prices, breakdowns, visit details, reviews) in a card.
**Don't** use coloured chip badges for status, or green for an added charge (it is accent, "your move").
**Don't** show percentages in any money copy ("Taily fee −$12.50", never "10 %").
**Don't** use outline secondary buttons outside a confirm sheet / modal or a two-path empty state.
**Don't** use `transition: all`, or animate an overlay in from `scale(0)`.
**Don't** use a base semantic colour (`--error`, `--success`, `--warning`) or `--neutral-500` / `--accent-base` for text.
**Don't** call `--bottom-border` in new work; it is an unsorted Figma variable. New row rules use `--hairline`.
